title: Couldn’t he fly a bit higher than that, eh?
html_source: This line uses the tale of Icarus and Daedalus (Icarus flies too close to the sun and plummets to his death, you know the drill) as a metaphor for whether Stephen’s ever going to accomplish anything in life, and connects with his last name (Dedalus).
